editorial:
Imagine waking up one day and suddenly remembering a whole other life you never lived. That is exactly what happens to Peter Proud, a college professor who starts having weird flashes of memories from the past. He feels a strong pull toward a town he has never visited, but as soon as he gets there, everything feels like home. The vibe is very spooky and mysterious, making you feel like something is slightly off from the moment he arrives. You will find yourself wondering if he is actually losing his mind or if there is something supernatural happening behind the scenes.

What really works here is how the mystery builds up slowly, keeping you guessing about who Peter actually was in his past life. The acting is solid, and the twists are surprising enough to keep you interested. While some parts of the story move a bit slow, the payoff is worth it. If you enjoy old-school mysteries with a touch of the paranormal, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: You find out that Peter is the reincarnation of a man who was murdered. The big twist is that the people who killed him in the past are still around or their secrets are still hiding. Peter eventually faces the person responsible for the old crime. After the truth comes out and the bad guy is dealt with, Peter finally finds peace and can stop the scary flashes from bothering him.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves reincarnation stories and old mystery movies.
